messages.content: Help me ensure that a new line is emitted before the leading comments of a node with position 42 in a TypeScript file, using a lineMap object named 'tsLineMap' and a writer object named 'tsWriter'?

function.name: emitNewLineBeforeLeadingComments
function.description: This function ensures that a new line is emitted before the leading comments of a specified node within a TypeScript file. Note that the provided function is in JavaScript syntax.

lineMap.description: An object representing the line map of the TypeScript file. This parameter can be of any type of JavaScript object in string representation.

writer.description: An object used for writing to the TypeScript file. This parameter can be of any type of JavaScript object in string representation.

node.description: The position of the node.. This is JavaScript integer type parameter in string representation.

leadingComments.description: An array of leading comment objects associated with the node. Default empty array This parameter can be of any type of JavaScript object in string representation.
